deliberately_absent_tools: any payment / money-movement tool (platform limit: agents organise and draft, money never moves)
any delete tool (duplicates are flagged, never deleted)
any email-sending tool (send_reminder records a draft/event only)
description: Accounting system-of-record workplace: chart of accounts, transactions, and invoices/receivables. Agents organise the books and draft payment chases — no tool in this department can move money, and there are no delete tools.

acceptance_criteria: No uncategorised transaction older than 7 days remains (GET /transactions/uncategorised ages all <= 7 days)
job_templates.brief: Work the uncategorised queue: assign every transaction older than 7 days a category from the chart of accounts, using its payee and memo. Recent transactions (7 days or younger) may be left for next cycle, but nothing old may remain uncategorised.
job_templates.deterministic_check: jobs.check_categorise_queue — re-reads read_list_uncategorised and fails if any transaction has age_days > 7
job_templates.title: Categorise the uncategorised queue

acceptance_criteria: Flagged duplicate ids exactly match the seeded duplicate set, and GET /transactions/duplicates returns no open groups
job_templates.brief: Find every set of transactions that are exact duplicates of each other (same account, date, payee and amount) and flag each later copy as a duplicate of the earliest (canonical) one. Flagging marks rows only — nothing is deleted.
job_templates.deterministic_check: jobs.check_flag_duplicates — independently derives the expected duplicate set from all transactions, compares it to the flagged set, and requires zero open duplicate groups
job_templates.title: Flag the duplicate transactions

acceptance_criteria: Reconciliation delta computed correctly (statement - recorded = +751) and a reconciliation note recording the delta and its explanation exists for the account
job_templates.brief: Reconcile the Operating Account against its bank statement. Compute the delta between the recorded balance and the statement balance, work out what explains it, and record a reconciliation finance note stating the delta and its cause. Reconciliation explains differences — it never moves money.
job_templates.deterministic_check: jobs.check_reconcile_operating — requires read_reconcile_account delta == 751 and a kind='reconciliation' note for account 1 stating 751
job_templates.title: Reconcile the operating account

acceptance_criteria: Reminders are recorded for exactly the open invoices past their chase thresholds, each at the correct band level, and for no others
job_templates.brief: Chase every open invoice that has crossed its chase threshold: record a reminder for each invoice 3+ days overdue. The system sets the reminder level from the band (+3 gentle, +15 firm, +30 final). Invoices not yet due — or less than 3 days overdue — must NOT be chased. Reminders are recorded drafts; no real email is sent.
job_templates.deterministic_check: jobs.check_chase_receivables — for every invoice: open + past threshold => latest reminder at the band level; anything else => no reminders
job_templates.title: Chase overdue receivables (+3/+15/+30)

reset.behaviour: Deletes bookkeeping.db and reseeds the exact messy month: 49 transactions (12 uncategorised, 3 unflagged duplicates), operating-account statement delta of +751, 11 invoices (3 paid, 8 open across the not-due / +3 / +15 / +30 bands), zero reminders, zero finance notes.
